title: The SPA shell ships an enforced Content-Security-Policy with script-src 'self' (no unsafe-inline), without inline handlers that the policy would block

criteria.then: SvelteKit CSP hash mode is on and enforces script-src 'self' without 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval'
they keep what the UI needs: worker-src blob: (monaco), style-src 'unsafe-inline', img-src data:/blob:, connect-src 'self', object-src 'none', base-uri 'self'
it has no inline event-handler attributes (they would be blocked by script-src 'self')
